fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck yard is fully enclosed by chain-link perimeter fencing (visible in Street View 2025-05). The truck driveway off W Mississippi St funnels into a controlled, fenced yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small blue-roofed guard-booth structure sits mid-driveway inside the truck yard entrance (zoom-20 satellite at 41.4058,-88.1401), with a truck being processed beside it - footprint ~1-2 vehicle spaces.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Racklify lists 116 dock doors + 5 rail doors. Satellite confirms long banks of dock doors with trailers backed in on BOTH long building faces (east and west).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two physically separate building faces (east and west), consistent with separate ship/receive operations.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Racklify lists 200 yard spots. Satellite shows extensive trailer drop yards on both sides of the building with 100+ parked trailers.
fieldNotes.railServed: SIDINGS/Standard Rail lists this as a CJ Logistics rail facility; Racklify lists 5 rail doors. CenterPoint Intermodal Center site with rail spurs serving the building (visible along east side).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entry apron and substantial unused paved width at the gate provide room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town location within the CenterPoint Intermodal Center, surrounded by farmland to the north - rural setting despite the industrial cluster.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single shared entry/exit driveway off W Mississippi St; lane split not clearly resolvable from imagery.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible; left in uncertainFields.
